name: natlas-js-monorepo
description: Developer infrastructure for N-ATLaS, Nigeria's multilingual LLM: TypeScript SDK, web playground and a $0 self-hosting recipe.
author: Bonnke Olaitan (https://github.com/olaxbonnke)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @olaxbonnke/natlas-js && npm run build -w natlas-playground
scripts.dev: npm run build:sdk && npm run dev -w natlas-playground
scripts.test:examples: cd examples/whatsapp-bot && vitest run && cd ../telegram-bot && vitest run
